name: Spider-Man
hook: Three film Spider-Men, one motto, and the villains who kept coming back.

facts.label: Peter Parker
facts.statement: Peter Parker is Spider-Man, the "friendly neighborhood" hero whose motto is "With great power comes great responsibility."

facts.label: Stan Lee
facts.statement: Stan Lee co-created Spider-Man and cameoed in the films, including The Amazing Spider-Man.

facts.label: Sam Raimi
facts.statement: Sam Raimi directed the 2002 Spider-Man after making his name with The Evil Dead at 22.

facts.label: Tobey Maguire
facts.statement: Tobey Maguire played Peter Parker and Spider-Man in the 2002 film and reads "The Song of Hiawatha" in Spider-Man 2.

facts.label: the Green Goblin
facts.statement: Willem Dafoe played the Green Goblin in all three Tobey Maguire Spider-Man films.

facts.label: Doctor Octopus
facts.statement: Doctor Octopus, Otto Octavius, was played by Alfred Molina in 2004's Spider-Man 2.

facts.label: Tom Holland
facts.statement: Tom Holland plays Peter Parker in Spider-Man: Homecoming and Far From Home.
